summary: Preserved the candidate's valid caller-ID API and Kimi K3 image cache work, reproduced and fixed its native video-only alignment defect, and retained the unimplemented cross-processor video/audio/Responses contract as explicit limitations.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate rejected one native video and one cache ID with 'mm_cache_ids has 1 entries for 0 images'.
Native video-only, mixed image/video/audio ordering, batched video IDs, API retention/validation, and Kimi K3 artifact-cache behavior: 94 passed and 27 subtests passed.
All SGLang runtime Python sources compile from the prepared checkout.
OpenAI Chat and Responses serving compatibility: 170 passed and 70 subtests passed; no real-model previous_response_id no-I/O behavior is inferred.
Only python/sglang/srt/multimodal/processors/kimi_k3.py consumes the shared artifact path.

gpu_execution.evidence: Torch saw one AMD Instinct MI355X with ROCm build 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but compatible multimodal weights were unavailable. The tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify multimodal caching, so no unrelated GPU smoke is claimed.

remaining_limitations: No video processor passes caller cache IDs to prepare_media_artifacts, so video no-I/O hot hits remain unimplemented and unverified.
No audio processor passes caller cache IDs to prepare_media_artifacts, so audio no-I/O hot hits remain unimplemented and unverified.
Operational caller-ID artifact caching remains limited to the Kimi K3 image path rather than images generally.
No compatible multimodal weights were available to prove Responses previous_response_id avoids historical media I/O, decode, preprocessing, and hashing.
No native source changed; no native rebuild was applicable.
